verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no first-party documentation of GitLab's own external issue tracker integration, such as viewing or managing Jira tickets inside GitLab or linking them from merge requests. The only related items are third-party partner tools: Unito sync, Relokia migration, a vague monday.com integration, and Notion pulling GitLab data outward. None of these shows GitLab itself delivering the capability, so they earn no credit.
